item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json; from work import evaluate; reqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); pol=json.load(open('policy.json')); print(json.dumps([evaluate(r,pol) for r in reqs], sort_keys=True));\\n# focused checks: complete states, missing equivalence, ignored/undeclared, uniqueness/sort, immutability\\nimport copy\\ncases=[({'declared':['b','a','a','ignored'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1','name':'old'},'b':{'kind':'missing'},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'extra':1},'current':{'a':{'hash':'1','kind':'file','name':'new'},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'extra':2}}, {'ignored':['ignored']}, {'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}), ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})]\\nfor r,p,want in cases:\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(r),copy.deepcopy(p); got=evaluate(r,p); assert got==want,(got,want); assert r==rb and p==pb\\nprint('checks passed')\"]}"}
